newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler extends, revises U.S. incentives.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler extends, revises U.S. incentives.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Tuesday it extended its national incentives on most 1997 model cars and trucks through October 6, but eliminated the option of cut-rate financing on several vehicles.

Chrysler said it extended cash incentives on 1996 models, ranging from $200 to $3,000, through August 30. Incentives on the 1996 Chrysler New Yorker and the 1996 and 1997 Chrysler LHS cars were extended through October 31.
Chrysler changed no dollar amounts on its cash incentives. But it did eliminate the alternative of reduced rate financing on several vehicles.

It now offers cash-only incentives on the following vehicles: Dodge Avenger, Caravan, Grand Caravan, Intrepid, Neon and Stratus; Chrysler Cirrus, Sebring Coupe, Concorde and Town & Country; Plymouth Neon, Breeze, Voyager and Grand Voyager; and Eagle Vision.

The company is still offering a choice of cash or reduced interest rates on the 1996 Chrysler New Yorker; 1996 Jeep(R) Cherokee SE, Sport, Classic and Country; 1996 Dodge Dakota; 1996 and 1997 Eagle Talon, Chrysler LHS, Dodge Ram Van and Dodge Ram Wagon.
